edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to vrfAddress in the authorization require, so a caller-controlled value gates entry.
msg.sender is used as the bettor address when placing an ETH-funded bet.
cancelBet authorizes using require(betQueue[index].bettor==msg.sender).
canCancelBet checks the last bettor against msg.sender.
getBetState filters the queue by the caller-supplied bettor address.
receiveApproval performs an external token transferFrom call.
Bet state is written in _placeBet after the external transferFrom call returns.
placeBetEth makes an external payable call to buyTokens on the exchange.
Bet queue mutation happens after the external exchange call.
_placeBet calls resolvePriorBets which performs token payouts to external addresses.
resolvePriorBets invokes payout in a loop, enabling repeated external token transfers before indexes advance.
payout executes an external VRF token transfer to the winner.
resolvePriorBets calls random to decide the winner.
random delegates its raw number generation to maxRandom.
maxRandom computes randomness from blockhash, a block-dependent and miner-influenceable value.
resolvePriorBets reads and advances the state variable index over the betQueue.
index is incremented (index+=2 / index+=1) without overflow checks during resolution.
indexBetPlace is written when queueing a bet and grows unboundedly.
_placeBet executes indexBetPlace+=1, an unchecked plain arithmetic operation.
betQueue entries control payout amounts and recipients inside the resolution loop.
Bet records supply the recipient and amount used by payout.
victoryMessages are emitted when finalizing bets during resolution.
